items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: A white boy from Dallas called Speck, he was freckled face. He had slipped up to her dressing room...

ctx.x: Oh, here we go into this thing. A white boy from Dallas called Speck, he was freckled face. He had slipped up to her dressing room and made himself acquainted while

I was at work, you know. Across the street. And introduced her to a hyperdermic, showing how many CC's and everything and her being adventursome, she went for it. And every night that he came by, he was giving it to her free until finally she had to have it, then he was coming back and getting the money.
